sentences.text: Callawayasaurus is classified as a genus of plesiosaur within the family Elasmosauridae.
This large marine reptile had a skull measuring 35 cm and a total body length between 7.4 and 8 meters.
Its elongated nares, or nostrils, were positioned over the maxilla, which contained between 3 and 5 teeth.
The neck of Callawayasaurus contained 56 vertebrae, which were relatively short compared to other elasmosaurids.
Fossils of this species lack pectoral bars, a structural element found in other plesiosaur species.
The species was originally described by Samuel Paul Welles in 1962 as Alzadasaurus colombiensis and later reclassified into the genus Callawayasaurus by Kenneth Carpenter in 1999.
The genus name Callawayasaurus honors the paleontologist Jack M. Callaway.
The first remains were discovered in the Paja Formation near Leiva, Boyaca, Colombia.
A nearly complete skeleton found to be more robust than the holotype suggests that Callawayasaurus may have exhibited sexual dimorphism.
